description: Land Acquisition - Veddukadu Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi District - Gowtharimunai, Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi District (Sec. 05)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition for public purposes. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is only in his capacity as the authority making the declaration under the Land Acquisition Act. The core content is exclusively about land matters - property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition procedures - making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
